description: Agent skills for fallow, codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript. Teaches AI agents how to find unused code, duplication, circular deps, complexity hotspots, architecture drift, design-system drift, and (with Fallow Runtime) hot-path and cold-path evidence. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 30+ agents.
